verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB says each agent run can get its own throwaway branch of production data on isolated compute, so agents can experiment without affecting production (docs-13). Agents can also run on isolated read-only compute (docs-12), a free dev instance is available for testing (docs-10), and CHKit offers test commands for schema and pipelines in CI (docs-11). missing for 10: detailed docs on how branching works and how branch writes are isolated from production storage, independent or hands-on confirmation of the branching feature.
